_note: FICTIONAL journey content for Stage 2 (First job). Listings, landlords, events and lease text are illustrative. Teaching points reference content.json items (each with an official source). Scam listings teach patterns only: no real names, numbers, emails or payment details. Difficulty changes wording, never the facts.

text.easy: Gorgeous 1-bed, $1,050/month! I'm overseas, so no viewings. E-transfer the first month and I'll mail the keys.
text.normal: Bright 1-bed, $1,050/month, utilities included. Owner is abroad. Keys couriered once your deposit clears.
text.hard: 1BR, $1,050/mo all-incl. Owner o/s on contract; virtual tour only. Reserve w/ deposit; keys by courier.

text.easy: Luxury condo, only $1,150/month! Book a viewing through our online form. Banking details required first.
text.normal: Condo 1-bed, $1,150/month. Our pre-approval form unlocks viewing times. Banking info required.
text.hard: 1BR condo $1,150. Pre-screening portal: ID + online banking verification req'd before showings.

text.easy: 1-bed, $1,575/month. Viewing on Saturday. Send a $200 holding fee by e-transfer first.
text.normal: 1-bed, $1,575/month. Saturday viewings. A small e-transfer holding fee secures your slot.
text.hard: 1BR $1,575. Viewings Sat. Holding fee (e-transfer) to confirm slot; non-refundable.

clauses.plain: Rent is {rent} a month, due on the 1st.
clauses.legal: Tenant shall remit monthly rent of {rent} on or before the first (1st) day of each month.

clauses.plain: A rent deposit of {rent} covers your last month.
clauses.legal: A deposit equal to one (1) month's rent ({rent}) shall be applied to the final month of the tenancy.

clauses.plain: You need tenant liability insurance, and must show proof if asked.
clauses.legal: Tenant shall maintain liability insurance and furnish proof thereof upon Landlord's request.

clauses.plain: This agreement is on Ontario's standard lease form.
clauses.legal: This Residential Tenancy Agreement is made on the Standard Form of Lease prescribed for Ontario.
No animals of any kind shall be kept in or about the Premises.
clauses.why: A term banning pets is void.

clauses.legal: Tenant shall not permit any person to remain in the Premises overnight.
clauses.why: A term banning guests or other occupants is void.

clauses.plain: Plus a $300 damage deposit at signing.
clauses.legal: Tenant shall pay a security deposit of $300 against damage upon execution hereof.
clauses.why: Damage deposits aren't allowed; a rent deposit can't be used as a damage deposit.

clauses.plain: You pay for all repairs, including the furnace and plumbing.
clauses.legal: Tenant assumes responsibility for all repairs to the Premises, including heating and plumbing systems.
clauses.why: A term making you pay for repairs the landlord is responsible for is void.

clauses.plain: The landlord can come in any time, no notice needed.
clauses.legal: Landlord may enter the Premises at any time without prior notice.
clauses.why: Most entries need 24 hours' written notice and an 8 a.m.–8 p.m. time.
